address.grain: one source address identifier per dataset version

parcel.grain: one source parcel polygon per dataset version

urban_tree.grain: one mapped tree point per dataset version

weather_observation.grain: one weather station observation at one timestamp

heat_observation.grain: one spatial heat observation feature or summary for one observation date

vegetation_observation.grain: one vegetation feature or summary for one observation date

cost_estimate.grain: one greening option, tree type where applicable, context, unit and validity period
